items.followUp: How does humidity affect the rate of transpiration?

rubric.why: States the effect of increasing temperature on transpiration.
rubric.description: As temperature rises, the rate of transpiration generally increases.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that higher temperature increases the rate of transpiration.

rubric.why: Explains why increased temperature raises the rate.
rubric.description: Higher temperature speeds up evaporation of water from leaf surfaces and the loss of water vapour from leaves.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for explaining the effect through faster evaporation or faster water-vapour loss.

modelAnswer: As temperature rises, the rate of transpiration generally increases.
Higher temperature speeds up evaporation of water from leaf surfaces and the loss of water vapour from leaves.

items.followUp: What is the role of red blood cells?

rubric.description: Platelets are small cell fragments present in the blood.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying platelets as small blood-cell fragments.

rubric.why: States the main function of platelets.
rubric.description: They help blood to clot at a wound and prevent excessive blood loss.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that platelets help clot blood or prevent blood loss.

modelAnswer: Platelets are small cell fragments present in the blood.
They help blood to clot at a wound and prevent excessive blood loss.

items.followUp: Write a short note on any three careers related to Biology.

rubric.why: Names a biology-related medical career and describes its work.
rubric.description: Medicine: doctors use biology to diagnose and treat diseases in humans.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming medicine or doctors and describing diagnosis or treatment of disease.

rubric.why: Describes the application of biology to crop production.
rubric.description: Agriculture: biological knowledge helps improve crops and crop production.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming agriculture and describing a relevant role in improving crops or their production.

rubric.why: Names a career involving fish or other aquatic organisms.
rubric.description: Fisheries: biology is used to breed, rear, and manage fish and other aquatic organisms.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming fisheries and describing the breeding, rearing, or management of aquatic organisms.

rubric.why: Describes a career involving forest management or conservation.
rubric.description: Forestry: biologists help manage and conserve forests.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming forestry and describing forest management or conservation.

rubric.why: Describes a career involving the care and breeding of animals.
rubric.description: Animal husbandry: biology is applied to the breeding, rearing, and care of livestock.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for naming animal husbandry and describing the breeding, rearing, or care of livestock.

modelAnswer: Medicine: Doctors use biology to diagnose and treat diseases in humans.
Agriculture: Biological knowledge helps improve crops and crop production.
Fisheries: Biology is used to breed, rear, and manage fish and other aquatic organisms.
Forestry: Biologists help manage and conserve forests.
Animal husbandry: Biology is applied to the breeding, rearing, and care of livestock.
